lines.zh: 发出低沉的吼声，步履沉重。
lines.en: Rumbles with a deep growl, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 用粗大的爪子在地上划过。
lines.en: Scratches the ground with large claws.

lines.zh: 我一路碾过矮树，枝条乱响。
lines.en: I trample the scrub and branches crack behind me.

lines.zh: 眼睛闪烁着绿色的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with green light.

lines.zh: 舌头舔了舔嘴角的树叶。
lines.en: Tongue licks the leaves at its mouth.

lines.zh: 用鼻子嗅着空气中的气味。
lines.en: Sniffing the air with its nose.

lines.zh: 我这一声吼，丛林都静了。
lines.en: One roar and the jungle goes silent.

lines.zh: 缓慢向前移动，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Slowly moves forward, searching for prey.
Scrub bends when I push through.

lines.zh: 用鼻子轻轻嗅着周围的空气。
lines.en: Sniffing the air gently with its nose.
Turning its head to observe the surroundings.

lines.zh: 缓缓舔着马平瓜里之眼。
伸长脖子，欣赏周围的风景。
lines.en: Extending its neck to admire the scenery.
Closing its eyes, enjoying the sunlight.
That roar in the jungle is mine.
My tusks grind with a rasp.
Scrubbing my back on a trunk.
The wind on the savanna is dry.

lines.zh: 那只眼睛还攥在我手里。
lines.en: I still hold that eye in my fist.
My growl is low as distant thunder.
The jungle's edge is too bright.

lines.zh: 我那只独眼，缓缓转过来。
lines.en: My single eye turns slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音，像远处打雷。
lines.en: The sound in my throat is like distant thunder.

lines.zh: 舌头伸出口外，威胁玩家。
lines.en: Tongue extends out, threatening the player.

lines.zh: 獠牙间还挂着半片叶子。
lines.en: Half a leaf still hangs from my tusks.

lines.zh: 用爪子在地上刻画警告。
lines.en: Scratching warnings in the ground with claws.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，判断你有多重。
lines.en: I tilt my head and judge your weight.

lines.zh: 眼睛发出警告，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Eyes glowing, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 爪子在地上划出三道深沟。
lines.en: My claws carve three deep furrows.
Two hundred points of life. Don't underestimate it.
You do not smell of rot. Go.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，可这一下进肉了。
lines.en: My hide is thick, but that one bit in.
My hide is so thick your blade dulls.

lines.zh: 巨大藤蔓缠绕我的身体，求你莫要靠近！
你靠近我太近了，别碰我！
lines.en: You're too close, don't touch me!
Don't eat me, I'll attack you!

lines.zh: 快给我自由，我要去丛林！
lines.en: Free me, I want to go to the jungle!
My fangs are sharp, be careful!
Don't set me on fire, I'll burn!

lines.zh: 喂我肉块，我会不攻击你！
lines.en: Give me meat, I won't attack you!
Don't cut me down, I'll fight back!

lines.zh: 你若驯服我，我可以助你一臂之力！
lines.en: Tame me, and I'll help you!

lines.zh: 别伤害我，我要保护我的家园！
lines.en: Don't hurt me, I protect my home!

lines.zh: 小心！我的藤蔓会缠住你！
lines.en: Be careful, my vines will get you!

lines.zh: 藤蔓碰撞产生静电，小心触电！
藤蔓缠绕你，我不会放你走！
lines.en: Vines will entangle you, I won't let go!

lines.zh: 藤蔓互相碰撞，发出啪啪声！
藤蔓缠绕，我不会轻易让开！
lines.en: Vines entangle, I won't give way!

lines.zh: 藤蔓纠缠，阻止你的探索！
藤蔓相互摩擦，发出摩擦声！
求求你，不要伤害我的伴侣！
我需要我的伴侣，我们是彼此的！
lines.en: I need my mate, we belong together!
My mate is important, protect her!

lines.zh: 求你别分开我们，我们是唯一的！
lines.en: Don't separate us, we're the only ones!

lines.zh: 求你让开，我要保护我的伴侣！
lines.en: Move, I need to protect my mate!

lines.zh: 我们是彼此的归宿，保护她！
lines.en: We're each other's home, protect her!

lines.zh: 求你不要伤害我的伴侣，她是唯一的！
lines.en: Don't hurt my mate, she's the only one!

lines.zh: 我需要我的伴侣，守护她！
lines.en: I need my mate, protect her!

lines.zh: 我们的爱是唯一的，保护她！
lines.en: Our love is unique, protect her!

lines.zh: 求你不要分开我们，我们是彼此的！
lines.en: Don't separate us, we're each other's!
Feeding on the roots of vines
Glares at you with hunger in its eyes

lines.zh: 用触手探索周围的环境

lines.en: In the jungle, I give up not one step.

lines.zh: 一声低吼，林子的鸟全飞了。
lines.en: One roar and every bird in the trees takes off.

lines.zh: 丛林里那股腐味，就是我。
lines.en: That rotting smell in the jungle is me.
Sixteen points of force. It will hurt.

lines.zh: 稀疏丛林里，我的吼声先到。
lines.en: In the sparse jungle, my roar arrives first.

lines.zh: 我贴地压过去，树影都抖了。
lines.en: I press low toward you and the tree shadows shake.
Growls and lunges at the foe

lines.zh: 用强壮的身体撞击敌人
lines.en: Collides with foes using its strength
Its roar shakes the leaves down.

lines.zh: 这一爪下去，腐叶全翻起来。
lines.en: This claw strike turns up all the rotting leaves.
Appears on the edge of a tropical savanna

lines.zh: 稀树丛里，我慢慢直起背。
lines.en: In the open woodland, I slowly straighten my back.
Appears in the jungle at night

lines.zh: 稀树丛里立起一团影子。
lines.en: A shadow rises in the open woodland.

lines.zh: 身体被撕裂，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Skin torn! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我这么厚的皮，刀都滑开。
lines.en: This thick hide makes blades slide off.
